name: orient equations into rules and add the normal forms of critical overlaps as new rules
mechanism: turn each equation into a rewrite rule pointing downhill in a termination order; wherever two rules' left sides overlap, rewrite the overlap both ways to normal forms; if the results differ, orient that pair as a new rule; repeat until no overlap yields a new rule, when rewriting decides equality

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Knuth–Bendix completion algorithm' in section Computational mathematics / Computer algebra: for rewriting rule systems

requires: a termination order that can orient every equation
fails_when: an unorientable equation halts the procedure; may run forever
